This article is about the current grid of blocks.   For the upcoming grid, see /upcoming.   For the list of blocks in one table, see Debug mode/Blocks.



This feature is exclusive to Java Edition. 

This page lists all the rows in the debug mode block grid in Java Edition 26.2.
There are 180 lines with up to 181 block states. The last line has 146 block states. Of these 179, those that appear at the end of a line are repeated at the beginning of the next. Therefore, there are 32,545 block states in total, with 32,366 unique block states.
The first block is located at coordinates (1, 70, 1) and each block is 2 blocks away from its adjacent blocks, thus the block in row r, column c is at coordinates (2r-1, 70, 2c-1).
